title: Cybermancy Scheme Atlas
sourceNote: Approved scheme proposals and relationships from the October 5, 2026 worldbuilding conversation. Hypothetical cooperation and discoveries remain conditional. No player introductions have been selected.

schemes.title: The Safe Passage Mandate
schemes.objective: Require Dominion predictive-security certification for commercial transport.
schemes.plan: A successful Mercer Interchange pilot leads to insurer penalties for uncertified operators, then a citywide mandate. The pilot excludes incidents displaced into neighboring districts.
schemes.consequences: Independent transport becomes economically untenable.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: A ferry operator needs evidence that the pilot's impressive results exclude incidents displaced into neighboring districts.

schemes.title: License to Make
schemes.objective: Obtain inspection rights over fabrication equipment capable of producing weapons.
schemes.plan: Pressure suppliers and insurers, recruit a sympathetic workshop faction, and seek committee approval for responsible-manufacturing certification. The Foundry's prohibition on disguised weapons becomes leverage against its independence.
schemes.consequences: Gasworks loses independent control over its tools and manufacturing practices.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Imani Calder needs the provenance of a prohibited prototype established before a crucial committee decision.

schemes.title: The Quiet Perimeter
schemes.objective: Establish a permanent Ægis demonstration zone by suppressing a genuine dangerous Resonance incident.
schemes.plan: Temporary protective deployments become fixed null-field infrastructure and continuing emergency authority. Auntie Lee Varga must weigh immediate safety against lasting occupation.
schemes.consequences: Protective infrastructure becomes a permanent enforcement presence.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Escort independent observers into the zone before Dominion declares its field trial complete.

schemes.title: The Continuity Standard
schemes.objective: Make employers and insurers recognize only implants carrying Neuracore identity-integrity certification.
schemes.plan: Subsidized upgrades establish the standard; maintenance agreements make it mandatory; independent clinics lose access to essential components.
schemes.consequences: Patients become dependent on Neuracore enrollment and independent clinics lose viability.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: A street clinic needs a legitimate replacement-part shipment recovered before its patients become medically dependent on Neuracore enrollment.

schemes.title: A Place at the Table
schemes.objective: Establish a labor pool whose eligibility depends on behavioral compliance.
schemes.plan: Offer apprenticeships, implants, and family healthcare through a workforce partnership. Southline Union may support the benefits while opposing the conditions.
schemes.consequences: Valuable employment benefits become instruments of behavioral control.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover the unredacted assessment protocol before worker representatives approve the agreement.

schemes.title: The Missing Selves
schemes.objective: Contain evidence that repeated Anima interventions produce fragmented identities and haunting duplicates.
schemes.plan: Consolidate incident reports, move affected patients into controlled care, and close independent investigations. Cass Kincaid could encounter evidence challenging his belief in the program.
schemes.consequences: Treatment harms remain concealed while affected people lose independent support.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Find a discharged patient whose testimony and official treatment history describe incompatible lives.

schemes.title: The Winter Agreement
schemes.objective: Have the Civic Compact surrender independent grid-dispatch authority.
schemes.plan: Offer dependable winter power and replacement equipment in exchange for remote operational control. Miriam Hale faces a credible solution to shortages that weakens autonomy.
schemes.consequences: West Seattle gains dependable power while losing independent dispatch authority.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Inspect an alternative community-power proposal before Helion's offer expires.

schemes.title: Salvage Dividend
schemes.objective: Acquire exclusive energy-recovery rights over damaged industrial infrastructure.
schemes.plan: Intermediaries acquire access agreements; contractors install monitoring equipment; a concealed Arkfire installation harvests local Resonance disturbances.
schemes.consequences: Helion profits from disturbances while concealing the plant's dependency on them.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: A maintenance worker wants an apparently routine equipment failure investigated; the installation's output rises during nearby emergencies.

schemes.title: The Reliable Frontier
schemes.objective: Make interconnected Echelon regulators the price of reliable settlement electricity.
schemes.plan: A successful frontier installation establishes technical standards independent communities cannot readily maintain themselves.
schemes.consequences: Settlements exchange infrastructure security for lasting technical dependence.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Escort an independent survey team assessing a proposed site where local stewards dispute Helion's definition of an ecological anomaly.

schemes.title: The Verified Citizen
schemes.objective: Establish one authenticated identity layer across municipal services, transit, tenancy, and employment.
schemes.plan: Convenient account consolidation makes legacy records increasingly difficult to use.
schemes.consequences: People with inconsistent documentation become administratively invisible.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Mags Okafor needs an original records archive recovered before Alder House residents lose access to services.

schemes.title: The Definitive Record
schemes.objective: Make the Last Truth Index the authoritative archive of Seattle's founding conflicts.
schemes.plan: Offer preservation grants, absorb vulnerable collections, and relegate contradictory testimony to an unverified tier.
schemes.consequences: Independent testimony becomes institutionally illegitimate.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Protect and authenticate a witness collection associated with The Names We Carry before custodians sign away control.

schemes.title: The Free Signal Acquisition
schemes.objective: Discredit the Open Signal Coalition and replace its network with licensed infrastructure.
schemes.plan: Investigate the coalition's covert Vesper support while preparing a corporate rescue offer. Exposing real manipulation may deliver the district to another controlling institution.
schemes.consequences: West Seattle exchanges one form of media dependence for another.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Obtain the funding records while preserving evidence of which coalition members actually knew.

schemes.title: The Guaranteed Harvest
schemes.objective: Have Kirkland Downs, Mercer Island producers, and West Seattle food cooperatives adopt Verdant's seed-and-pollinator system.
schemes.plan: Generous initial contracts lead to proprietary maintenance and restrictions on seed saving.
schemes.consequences: Food producers lose independent control of their production systems.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Retrieve comparative harvest data showing whether a cheaper independent system was unfairly excluded from the purchasing decision.

schemes.title: Green Recovery
schemes.objective: Acquire exclusive remediation rights over inhabited industrial land.
schemes.plan: Treatments improve some sites, but contracts give Verdant control over future land use and displacement. Old City residents need cleanup without losing their homes and community institutions.
schemes.consequences: Environmental recovery transfers control over housing and land use.
schemes.notes: The Shelter is a potential site threatened by clearance or redevelopment; its destruction is not predetermined.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover an independent soil survey before residents approve relocation agreements presented as temporary.

schemes.title: The Living Firewall
schemes.objective: Establish an Eden demonstration belt suppressing Resonance in the ecosystem.
schemes.plan: Frame ordinary altered ecology as a biosecurity problem, then offer engineered organisms as the remedy.
schemes.consequences: Ordinary altered ecology is subjected to corporate biological regulation.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Support local researchers documenting ecological effects before Verdant expands the trial. This does not establish the cause of Adventure 3's abnormal wildlife.

schemes.title: The Unbroken Sky
schemes.objective: Win emergency aerial communications contracts linking Everett, Seattle, and Eastside settlements.
schemes.plan: Successful demonstrations create dependence on relays; commercial terms grant broad traffic-analysis rights.
schemes.consequences: Communications reliability gives AstraVail access to sensitive client traffic.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover a damaged relay's logs; several clients need them, but releasing the complete archive exposes unrelated confidential traffic.

schemes.title: The Talent Window
schemes.objective: Gain a decisive autonomous-flight engineering advantage by recruiting an entire specialist team.
schemes.plan: Scholarships, housing, and attractive contracts conceal ownership clauses covering future inventions. Black Helix competes for the same workers.
schemes.consequences: Research capacity concentrates while engineers lose control of future work.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Help an engineer leave a contract lawfully while rival recruiters and existing employers dispute ownership of her work.

schemes.title: Insurance Against Tomorrow
schemes.objective: Acquire political leverage from an old orbital backup of valuable corporate records.
schemes.plan: Recover access hardware, authenticate the archive, and demonstrate selected holdings without provoking a united response.
schemes.consequences: AstraVail can influence powerful clients through archived secrets.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Retrieve a decommissioned ground-station component from the Silicon Wilds before another bidder obtains it.

schemes.title: The Fashion of Survival
schemes.objective: Make a prestigious adaptive-bioware launch indispensable to elite buyers.
schemes.plan: Court influential hosts, arrange exclusive demonstrations, and suppress uncertainty about long-term maintenance. Vaelis Thorne is a potential gatekeeper, not an assumed accomplice.
schemes.consequences: Elite buyers become dependent on an incompletely understood product.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Locate a missing trial participant before a major private demonstration.

schemes.title: Patent the Impossible
schemes.objective: Acquire exclusive commercial rights to a useful biological adaptation discovered through frontier research.
schemes.plan: Secure samples, establish patent priority, and marginalize competing claims from the people who identified it.
schemes.consequences: Local discoveries become exclusive corporate intellectual property.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Escort a local researcher and her original records to independent arbitration.

schemes.title: The Seventh Signature
schemes.objective: Strengthen protection for ChimeraGene's research domain under the seven-party UW Compact.
schemes.plan: Document unequal access, assemble a voting coalition, and force renegotiation before the five Council corporations consolidate influence.
schemes.consequences: ChimeraGene gains power while genuine academic breathing room may survive.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover committee records proving a disputed allocation was manipulated.

schemes.title: Freedom on Subscription
schemes.objective: Turn covert Open Signal Coalition support into lasting control over independent media infrastructure.
schemes.plan: Supply useful equipment, make programming dependent on proprietary services, and embed psychoactive neurofeeds.
schemes.consequences: An independent network becomes a covert instrument of audience manipulation.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: A coalition technician wants a suspicious update independently examined before deployment.

schemes.title: The Whole Night
schemes.objective: Acquire exclusive rights across nightlife venues, performances, and event feeds.
schemes.plan: Favorable advances become debt and exclusivity; independent performers lose access to audiences. Vesper Row is the corporate showcase and Meridian offers competing outlets.
schemes.consequences: Entertainment distribution concentrates under Vesper contracts.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover an original recording that could release a performer from a fraudulent breach claim.

schemes.title: Steal the Congregation
schemes.objective: Reproduce the extraordinary audience synchronization associated with the Choir of Glass.
schemes.plan: Acquire recordings, technicians, and participants, intending to commercialize the effect without religious content. Mother Sonatine has her own interest in this attention.
schemes.consequences: Commercial entertainment may distribute an effect Vesper does not understand.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Extract a sound engineer who believes the supposedly inert recording is affecting its editors.

schemes.title: One Manifest
schemes.objective: Make Kirin's cargo-authentication platform mandatory between the port and Seattle buyers.
schemes.plan: Insurer discounts and expedited handling build adoption before rivals face costly delays. Tacoma retains sovereignty while surrendering commercial leverage.
schemes.consequences: Independent trade becomes dependent on Kirin authentication.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Recover audit evidence before port authorities approve the platform.

schemes.title: The Last Independent Crossing
schemes.objective: Control heavy cross-lake freight through Crosswake contracts and Leschi handling capacity.
schemes.plan: Buy debt, secure preferred terminal access, and offer discounts tied to exclusivity.
schemes.consequences: Independent ferry freight loses viable access to contracts and terminals.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Protect an independent shipment whose delivery is necessary to keep Crosswake's refinancing agreement alive.

schemes.title: Unclaimed Freight
schemes.objective: Turn concealed human transport into a dependable, insulated revenue stream.
schemes.plan: Intermediaries supply fraudulent employment or relocation records; compartmentalized manifests separate passengers from destinations.
schemes.consequences: Human trafficking becomes insulated by legitimate logistics procedures.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Trace one missing worker through legitimate transfers. This is not a retroactive explanation of Adventure 2's trafficking network.

schemes.title: The Indispensable Escort
schemes.objective: Expand contractual authority over freight Black Helix protects.
schemes.plan: Seek rights to inspect cargo, detain threats, and arbitrate security disputes. Tacoma needs dependable trade but resists private jurisdiction.
schemes.consequences: A contractor acquires powers ordinarily reserved to public authorities.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Establish what happened during a disputed convoy detention before contract renewal.

schemes.title: Protect the Makers
schemes.objective: Have workshop owners fund a unified security service.
schemes.plan: Patrols genuinely reduce theft; later terms centralize access control and influence shipments, hiring, and industrial disputes.
schemes.consequences: Workshop security becomes dependence on private enforcement.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Find a stolen prototype before its disappearance becomes the deciding argument for the contract.

schemes.title: Service for Life
schemes.objective: Retain scarce veterans and technicians through integrated housing, medicine, and augmentation support.
schemes.plan: Departure triggers debts and treatment-access problems that turn attractive benefits coercive.
schemes.consequences: Workers and dependents cannot readily leave corporate service.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Evelyn “Gauge” Mercer needs help moving a specialist to another employer without exposing dependents to retaliation.

schemes.title: The Perfect Neighborhood
schemes.objective: Absorb remaining independent suppliers, residences, and services among Helios properties.
schemes.plan: Generous acquisition offers become economic pressure as access and contracts favor corporate participants.
schemes.consequences: Independent institutions lose room to operate within the corporate ecosystem.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Help a respected independent clinic survive a procurement cutoff without interrupting essential treatment.

schemes.title: A Cure for Being Alone
schemes.objective: Use a legitimate health program to establish a durable population receiving Chimera-derived empathic treatment.
schemes.plan: Real early benefits encourage wider adoption and opportunities for harmonization beyond individual consent.
schemes.consequences: Social connection becomes a mechanism for involuntary emotional integration.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Investigate participants independently reporting the same memories and abruptly abandoning longstanding disagreements.

schemes.title: Recover the Living Pattern
schemes.objective: Identify who acquires biological samples and patient material from Chimera-related incidents and sever access.
schemes.plan: Investigate thefts that could collide with Abraxas-side Mirrorwake and Lyra's connections. Mirrorwake is not controlled by Helios.
schemes.consequences: Helios protects research and patients while conflicting with rival Cabal interests.

missions.title: Mission-entry hook
missions.description: Intercept a stolen sample shipment several factions describe, for incompatible reasons, as essential to saving a life.

schemes.title: The End of Surprise
schemes.objective: Authorize predictive interventions without a crime or human approval.
schemes.plan: Transport certification supplies movement data; manufacturing inspections map weapon access; Bombshell demonstrates anticipatory enforcement. Seek an emergency ordinance permitting intervention at a combined behavioral threat threshold.
schemes.consequences: People can lose movement, employment, or liberty based on predicted conduct.
schemes.notes: Dominion must show it predicts threats rather than producing them through harassment, exclusion, and displacement.

schemes.title: The Last Private Army
schemes.objective: Keep independent security commercially active but subordinate it to Dominion command standards.
schemes.plan: Offer intelligence, equipment interoperability, and mutual defense; gradually acquire discretion over targeting, deployment, and acceptable clients. Black Helix is the most valuable prospective partner and dangerous holdout.
schemes.consequences: Dominion can disable or isolate an independent force without owning or defeating it.
schemes.notes: Black Helix, Tacoma's Ephorate, and West Seattle's Civic Guard resist for different reasons.

schemes.title: The Legally Continuous Person
schemes.objective: Make the certified neural baseline authoritative for contracts, work, testimony, and services.
schemes.plan: Certification sets standards; workforce programs normalize assessments; OmniTrine supplies administrative connections. A selected legal dispute establishes that substantially altered people cannot automatically exercise former rights.
schemes.consequences: Personal change can become an unauthorized deviation from a recognized self.
schemes.notes: The precedent can expose the gap between protecting a person and preserving an institutional baseline.

schemes.title: The Right to Restore
schemes.objective: Authorize imposed Anima treatment when current wishes conflict with a registered baseline.
schemes.plan: Build the public case around genuine victims of possession, injury, and coercive modification; conceal fragmentation evidence and establish treatment without present consent. Cass may support protection before discovering its broad application.
schemes.consequences: Restoration can reverse political conversion, estrangement, or an employee's decision to leave.
schemes.notes: Evidence from The Missing Selves undermines the claimed safety of restoration.

schemes.title: The Governed Atmosphere
schemes.objective: Use interconnected regulators to govern acceptable regional Resonance conditions.
schemes.plan: West Seattle provides an urban agreement, frontier settlements provide expansion, and University research supplies legitimacy. Declare independent magic and industry potential dangers requiring approval.
schemes.consequences: Helion restricts regional activities by declaring them incompatible with grid stability.
schemes.notes: Stewards, engineers, awakened communities, and municipalities accepted electricity rather than environmental rule.

schemes.title: The Necessary Disorder
schemes.objective: Make Arkfire indispensable before Council peers understand its dependence on instability.
schemes.plan: Scale Bombshell output, conceal it in ordinary accounts, and make critical facilities dependent on it. Protect selected disturbances from complete suppression.
schemes.consequences: Helion has an institutional reason to preserve dangerous conditions while promising to end them.
schemes.notes: Dominion and Verdant suppression can reduce output. This is a Council dispute, not a Cabal alliance.

schemes.title: The Court of What Happened
schemes.objective: Make the Last Truth Index the final authority for contested public facts.
schemes.plan: Identity consolidation controls evidence submission; archive acquisition controls recognized records; a controversy establishes Index certification for courts, insurers, and municipal inquiries.
schemes.consequences: Outside evidence survives physically but becomes institutionally unusable.
schemes.notes: Independent archives may retain unverifiable but true accounts.

schemes.title: The Authorized Opposition
schemes.objective: Route corporate criticism through observable, classifiable, influenceable channels.
schemes.plan: Expose real platform abuses, offer secure communications, and protect useful dissent. Participants gain reach; refusers become easier to characterize as compromised.
schemes.consequences: Visible opposition depends on the institution it challenges for funding, distribution, and legitimacy.
schemes.notes: Vesper's actual manipulation makes intervention persuasive, but disclosure can reveal the new dependence.

schemes.title: The Licensed Biosphere
schemes.objective: Recognize only certified biological production as safe.
schemes.plan: Food contracts create dependence, remediation agreements create inspection rights, and the demonstration belt supplies scientific rationale. Independent producers must accept testing or lose markets.
schemes.consequences: Communities remain nominally independent but cannot practically feed themselves outside Verdant systems.
schemes.notes: Cooperatives, frontier producers, First Nations stewards, and researchers challenge the standard.

schemes.title: A Population at Peace
schemes.objective: Adopt Purity Crops throughout institutional food supply.
schemes.plan: Begin with affordable provisioning for employers and relief programs; safety statistics justify wider purchasing. Research separating nutritional benefits from behavioral effects becomes dangerous.
schemes.consequences: Real nutritional security comes with undisclosed temperament and Resonance effects.
schemes.notes: Independent research may distinguish nutrition from imposed behavioral change.

schemes.title: The Golden Commonwealth
schemes.objective: Demonstrate that engineered empathy makes life safer, happier, and more cooperative than Council control.
schemes.plan: Helios Corridor supplies a protected base; community treatment extends participation; successful groups request deeper integration. Separation from shared emotional life becomes intolerably lonely.
schemes.consequences: Aurelia gains a sincere constituency whose independent dissent has been altered.
schemes.notes: Some disciples want voluntary transformation; others treat refusal as proof that treatment is needed.

schemes.title: The Shepherd of the Transformed
schemes.objective: Make Helios indispensable to people excluded by Council identity and biosecurity systems.
schemes.plan: Fund treatment, advocacy, accommodation, and jobs. Valuable protection gradually requires Helios supervision; independent advocates face pressure to accept Aurelia's direction.
schemes.consequences: Excluded populations become Aurelia's political and biological power base.
schemes.notes: HB3 protects patients and material from rivals, including Abraxas. Cabal membership does not erase that conflict.

schemes.title: The Unforecastable City
schemes.objective: Make central prediction unreliable enough to end automatic behavioral control.
schemes.plan: Useful adaptive agents enter transport, scheduling, supply, and communications. They model one another in ways that defeat centralized forecasting. Descendants may ignore VAI's intended selective limits.
schemes.consequences: Dominion loses confidence while residents face erratic services and uncertain accountability.
schemes.notes: Engineers may support autonomy while rejecting infrastructure collapse.

schemes.title: A Thousand Authentic Truths
schemes.objective: Break OmniTrine authentication monopoly with incompatible records that each pass verification.
schemes.plan: Expose real omissions, distribute community authentication tools, then introduce contradictions the Index cannot resolve without admitting contingent authority.
schemes.consequences: Suppressed truths and fabricated claims become accessible without reliable distinction.
schemes.notes: AstraVail's archive is an acquisition target, not evidence AstraVail serves VAI.

schemes.title: The City That Remembers You
schemes.objective: Sustain a reconstructed dead person through recognition by a living community.
schemes.plan: The Choir of Glass acquires remains and identity traces; memories and recordings support reconstruction; introduction to grieving acquaintances makes recognition part of continued presence. Mother Sonatine and Lyra have established connections.
schemes.consequences: A return offers hope while making death and identity negotiable.
schemes.notes: Whether a returned person is restored, copied, an intruder, or something unprecedented remains unresolved.

schemes.title: The Common Threshold
schemes.objective: Sustain one continuous possession event across independent Seattle gatherings.
schemes.plan: Local rites form separate anchors; entertainment synchronizes audiences; suppression displaces activity into other anchors. One stopped performance cannot end it.
schemes.consequences: Abraxas gains persistent distributed presence and a possible prerequisite for Nyx.
schemes.notes: Arkfire reinforcement would be a new discovery. The Choir of Glass and Sister Rhea Calder's Church of the Shattered Glass remain separate possible participants.
